boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented learning environments in Payson Library, spanning quiet reading, project work, research help, and technology-enabled study.

cards.title: Quiet Study Zones
cards.subtitle: Payson Library · Malibu campus
cards.notes: Bring reading or focused coursework and choose one of the quiet areas distributed throughout Payson Library.
cards.short_summary: Scattered quiet areas for independent reading and coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Libraries identifies quiet study areas throughout Payson Library.
cards.access_notes: Payson Library visitors may enter for up to two hours daily to attend programming and consult print collections; confirm current access needs with the library.

cards.title: Payson Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Payson Library · Malibu campus
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a group session; individuals may use an unreserved room, though groups receive priority when rooms fill.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for group work, with limited individual use.
cards.evidence_claim: Payson Library has study rooms, and Pepperdine's policy allows current-student groups to reserve them for up to three hours per day.
cards.access_notes: Study rooms are for current students only. Groups may reserve up to three hours daily; unreserved rooms may be used by individuals.

cards.title: Digital Learning Lab
cards.subtitle: Payson Library · Malibu campus
cards.notes: Use this collaborative setting for open study or instruction when your work benefits from shared screens and nearby peers.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative environment for instruction and open study.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Libraries describes the Digital Learning Lab as a collaborative environment for instruction and open study.
cards.access_notes: Located in Payson Library; consult the library for current access and any instructional scheduling.

cards.title: Genesis Lab
cards.subtitle: Payson Library · Malibu campus
cards.notes: Plan a hands-on project session around the lab's emerging technology, including 3D printers and virtual-reality rigs.
cards.short_summary: A makerspace for technology-supported project work.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Libraries identifies Genesis Lab as a makerspace with 3D printers and virtual reality rigs.
cards.access_notes: Located in Payson Library; check library guidance before planning use of specialized equipment.

cards.title: Great Books Room
cards.subtitle: Payson Library · Malibu campus
cards.notes: Use the room for reading or discussion tied to the Great Books Program, and check library guidance before organizing a group.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated setting connected to Pepperdine's Great Books Program.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Libraries describes the Great Books Room as a setting for students and faculty of the Great Books Program.
cards.access_notes: Located in Payson Library; contact the library for current room-use guidance.

cards.title: Special Collections and Archives
cards.subtitle: Payson Library · Malibu campus
cards.notes: Build a research session around the books, archival materials, and historic documents supporting work across disciplines.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Libraries says Special Collections and Archives holds books, archives, and historic documents supporting research in multiple disciplines.
cards.access_notes: Located in Payson Library; consult library staff for current access to archival materials.

cards.title: The Rushford Center
cards.subtitle: Payson Library · Malibu campus
cards.notes: Start church-history research here and use the center's collection to locate materials on the Stone-Campbell Restoration Movement.
cards.short_summary: A focused research collection for church history.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Libraries identifies the Rushford Center as a repository for the Stone-Campbell Restoration Movement and Churches of Christ.
cards.access_notes: Located in Payson Library; consult library staff for current collection access.

cards.title: Academic Center for Excellence
cards.subtitle: Payson Library · Malibu campus
cards.notes: Bring a draft, outline, speech, presentation, or media project when you want targeted help alongside your study time.
cards.short_summary: Support for research, writing, presentations, and media projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Libraries says the Academic Center for Excellence provides help with research, writing, speeches, presentations, and media projects.
cards.access_notes: Located in Payson Library; check the Academic Center for Excellence for current appointment or drop-in guidance.

cards.title: Student Success Center
cards.subtitle: Payson Library · Malibu campus
cards.notes: Use this stop to pair coursework planning with academic support, then continue your work in the surrounding library spaces.
cards.short_summary: A library-based support point for academic progress.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Libraries describes the Student Success Center as empowering students throughout their academic career.
cards.access_notes: Located in Payson Library; check the Student Success Center for current service availability.

cards.title: Exhibit Gallery
cards.subtitle: Payson Library · Malibu campus
cards.notes: Take a short research break with the rotating displays, then use a current exhibition as a prompt for observation or class notes.
cards.short_summary: A rotating display space within the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Pepperdine Libraries describes the Exhibit Gallery as a rotating exhibit space featuring collection objects and loaned works.
cards.access_notes: Located in Payson Library; exhibition availability changes, so check the library's current lineup before visiting.
